# hyperlite_resource_pool (Resource)

A pool of VMs: an assignment on it gives rights on every VM it holds (a VM joins it with `hyperlite_vm.resource_pool`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_resource_pool" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "The web front ends"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Its description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The pool's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id.
terraform import hyperlite_resource_pool.web 1
```
